title: Undirected reachability encodings are path encodings
statement: If a binary string encodes a finite undirected graph with designated vertices joined by a path, then it is an encoding of a graph with designated vertices joined by a path, without any symmetry requirement on the adjacency relation.
hypotheses_covered: A binary string $x$ belongs to the undirected reachability language
